module: Career logbook (logbook.json in the save's career folder). Stores the entries displayed in the UI: unlocking of missions, delivery facilities, spawn points, and help/tutorial pages. On first launch (empty logbook), it creates the introduction entries (welcome, logbook, driving, delivery…) from ui/modules/careerLogbook/pages/<id>/.
notes: Each entry receives time = os.time(), entryId (increasing counter) and isNew = true.
getLogbook fires the onLogbookGetEntries(ret) hook so that other extensions add entries, then sorts by descending time (on a tie, by descending entryId).
setLogbookEntryRead only modifies isNew (not read); getPopups and getLogbookMostRecentUnread read the read field: these two fields are never synchronized in this file (probable inconsistency).
missionUnlocked reads mission.name before testing id: crashes if id is nil or unknown (mission nil).
logbookEntry reads the content.html file with readFile without checking that it exists.

getLogbook.desc: Returns a copy of the entries list, enriched by the onLogbookGetEntries hook and sorted from most recent to oldest.

getPopups.desc: Returns the unread entries (read false) marked isPopup.

returns.desc: Entries to display in a popup.

getLogbookMostRecentUnread.desc: Returns up to `limit` recent entries (hideInRecent excluded), placing unread ones first, then read ones.

limit.desc: Maximum number of entries, 3 by default.

setLogbookEntryRead.desc: Sets isNew = not read on the entry with identifier entryId. Ignores entryId == -1.

read.desc: true to mark it as read.

addNewLogbookEntry.desc: Creates the actual entry: sets time, entryId, isNew, inserts it at the head of the list (unless skipSave) and, if entry.showMessage and outside the tutorial, displays a UI message (guihooks Message, 15 s).

skipSave.desc: If true, the entry is returned but not stored.

missionUnlocked.desc: Called when a mission is unlocked: creates a progress entry with the mission name and image.

deliveryFacilityUnlocked.desc: Called when a delivery facility is unlocked: creates a progress entry (facility name and preview). Does nothing if the facility is not found.

spawnPointUnlocked.desc: Called when a spawn point is discovered: creates a progress entry with showMessage = true.

genericInfoUnlocked.desc: "Normal" information/tutorial entry; plays the UI_Checkpoint sound (only once per frame, never during the tutorial).

genericLogbookEntry.desc: Generic info-type entry, with no sound or special behavior.

logbookEntry.desc: Creates a help entry from a page id: title ui.introPopup.<id>.title, content from ui/modules/careerLogbook/pages/<id>/content.html (line breaks removed) and header.jpg image.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: loads logbook.json; if empty, creates the introduction entries in reverse order of the internal list.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: resets the sound guard (one sound max per frame).
